description: Add, update, or remove a PPP profile. Idempotent by name. update returns no_change when requested values match. Built-in profiles (default, default-encryption) cannot be removed — RouterOS blocks this and the error is surfaced.

confirmationToken.description: Token from a prior APPROVAL_REQUIRED response. Re-submit the identical call with this token to confirm the destructive action.

dnsServer.description: DNS server IP pushed to client

localAddress.description: Local IP assigned to router end of PPP link

remoteAddress.description: IP or pool name assigned to client

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

name: manage_ppp_profile
title: Manage PPP Profile
